h: Picking Your Mission and Exploring Wandsworth
p: Sandbox offers several different experiences, so choosing the right one is part of the fun. Titles have ranged from zombie survival and Wild West shootouts to pirate adventures and sci-fi missions, and some are noticeably more intense than others. If you're bringing a mixed group, ask the staff to recommend something that suits everyone. Take a moment to check the game's age guidance too, so nobody gets turned away on the day.

A big part of Sandbox's appeal is the way it records your session. After the game you'll often get a video showing your team in action, combining your real-world movements with the game footage. It's a great souvenir for birthdays and stag dos, and guaranteed to get laughs when you share it later.

Wandsworth is a part of south-west London that's been transformed in recent years. The old Ram Brewery site, where beer was brewed for centuries, is now the Ram Quarter, with new shops, bars and restaurants. The riverside along the Thames is great for a stroll, and the Wandle Trail follows the River Wandle south towards Croydon if you want a longer walk.

Battersea Park is a short hop away, with its boating lake, Peace Pagoda and children's zoo, making a great second stop for families. Clapham Junction is close by, with its own shops and bars along Northcote Road and St John's Road. With Wandsworth Town station nearby, getting in and out of the area is a doddle, so it's easy to fit your game into a wider day exploring this part of London.
